Hi I'm Petra. 
I am the founder and coach/therapist of Core Fit Canine, LLC. I am a certified Canine Strength and Conditioning Coach and a Certified Massage Therapist, and I am here to help your dog stay fit, happy and healthy with enriching, positive and fun fitness programs as well as canine massage — all tailored to the individual dog's needs and abilities.
I also specialize in truffle hunting and truffle dog training — one of the most fascinating canine activities I have been involved with. My approach combines science-based knowledge, real-world experience, and positive training methods — always with the goal of filling dogs' lives with joy and strengthening the partnership between them and their owners.   
Check out my website www.corefitcanine.com and my truffle dog YouTube channel https://www.youtube.com/@Idigtruffles for more info and videos. I also wrote a digital training guide on Truffle Dog Training called "The Art of Truffle Hunting", which is available on my website.
